As a biologist working on plant stress responses to heat and drought, understanding the broader trajectory of climate change is directly relevant to my research. This dashboard pulls canonical climate indicators from major scientific agencies (NOAA, NASA), alongside the main indicators of biodiversity loss (IUCN Red List, Living Planet Index), each updated regularly at their source. Data is fetched at render time, so this page reflects the most recent available records.

::: callout-note
## Data sources

-   **CO2**: [NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory](https://gml.noaa.gov/ccgg/trends/) -- Mauna Loa Observatory, monthly mean atmospheric CO2 since 1958
-   **Temperature**: [NASA GISTEMP v4](https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/) -- Global Land-Ocean Temperature Index, annual anomaly vs. 1951--1980 baseline
-   **Warming stripes**: methodology from [Ed Hawkins](https://showyourstripes.info/s) (University of Reading), norm period 1961--1990
-   **Biodiversity**: [IUCN Red List](https://www.iucnredlist.org/) and [Living Planet Index](https://www.livingplanetindex.org/) (WWF / ZSL), via [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/biodiversity)
-   **Extinct species list**: [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/) -- taxa whose IUCN status is *Extinct* or *Extinct in the Wild*
:::

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(httr)
library(DT)
```

```{r data_load, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ----- CO2: NOAA Mauna Loa monthly means -----
co2_url <- "https://gml.noaa.gov/webdata/ccgg/trends/co2/co2_mm_mlo.csv"
co2 <- tryCatch({
  raw <- read_csv(co2_url, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE)
  names(raw) <- c("year", "month", "decimal_date", "average", "deseason", "ndays", "sdev", "unc")
  raw |>
    filter(average > 0) |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(paste(year, month, "15", sep = "-")))
}, error = function(e) NULL)

# ----- Temperature: NASA GISTEMP annual anomaly -----
temp_url <- "https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/tabledata_v4/GLB.Ts+dSST.csv"
temp <- tryCatch({
  df <- read_csv(temp_url, skip = 1, na = "***", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    select(Year, `J-D`) |>
    filter(!is.na(`J-D`)) |>
    rename(year = Year, anomaly = `J-D`) |>
    mutate(year = as.integer(year),
           sign  = ifelse(anomaly >= 0, "Warmer", "Cooler"),
           smooth = as.numeric(stats::filter(anomaly, rep(1/10, 10), sides = 2)))

  # Re-centre to 1961-1990 norm for warming stripes
  ref_mean <- df |> filter(year >= 1961, year <= 1990) |> pull(anomaly) |> mean(na.rm = TRUE)
  df |> mutate(anomaly_stripes = anomaly - ref_mean)
}, error = function(e) NULL)
```

```{r data_load_biodiv, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ----- Biodiversity: IUCN Red List & Living Planet Index via Our World in Data -----
owid <- function(slug) {
  read_csv(paste0("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/", slug,
                  ".csv?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=true"),
           show_col_types = FALSE)
}

lpi <- tryCatch(owid("global-living-planet-index") |> filter(entity == "World"),
                error = function(e) NULL)

rli <- tryCatch({
  df <- owid("red-list-index") |> filter(entity == "World")
  df |> mutate(rli = df[[ncol(df)]]) |> select(year, rli)
}, error = function(e) NULL)

threatened <- tryCatch({
  thr <- owid("number-species-threatened")
  evl <- owid("number-species-evaluated-iucn")
  inner_join(thr, evl, by = c("entity", "year")) |>
    filter(year == max(year))
}, error = function(e) NULL)
threatened_all <- if (!is.null(threatened)) filter(threatened, entity == "All groups") else NULL
if (!is.null(threatened)) {
  threatened <- threatened |>
    filter(!grepl("^All ", entity), threatened_species > 0) |>
    mutate(share = round(100 * threatened_species / evaluated_species)) |>
    arrange(threatened_species)
}

extinct <- tryCatch(owid("extinct-species-since-1500") |> filter(year == max(year)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
extinct_all <- if (!is.null(extinct)) filter(extinct, entity == "All species") else NULL
if (!is.null(extinct)) {
  extinct <- extinct |>
    filter(entity != "All species", ex + ew > 0) |>
    arrange(ex + ew)
}

# ----- Extinct species list: Wikidata (IUCN status Extinct / Extinct in the Wild) -----
wikidata <- function(query) {
  res <- GET("https://query.wikidata.org/sparql",
             query = list(query = query),
             add_headers(Accept = "text/csv",
                         `User-Agent` = "cmaslard-site/1.0 (https://cmaslard.xyz)"),
             timeout(90))
  stop_for_status(res)
  read_csv(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), show_col_types = FALSE)
}

# Groups in priority order: an item may match several ancestors (e.g. birds are within Reptilia)
group_levels <- c("Mammals", "Birds", "Reptiles", "Amphibians", "Fishes", "Insects",
                  "Arachnids", "Crustaceans", "Molluscs", "Other animals", "Plants", "Fungi", "Other")

extinct_list <- tryCatch({
  species <- wikidata('
    SELECT ?item ?species ?common ?status ?iucn (MIN(YEAR(?d)) AS ?year) WHERE {
      VALUES ?status { wd:Q237350 wd:Q239509 }
      ?item wdt:P141 ?status ; wdt:P225 ?species .
      OPTIONAL { ?item rdfs:label ?common FILTER(LANG(?common) = "en") }
      OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P627 ?iucn }
      OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P8556|wdt:P582 ?d }
    } GROUP BY ?item ?species ?common ?status ?iucn')

  groups <- wikidata('
    SELECT ?item ?group WHERE {
      VALUES ?status { wd:Q237350 wd:Q239509 }
      ?item wdt:P141 ?status .
      VALUES (?taxon ?group) {
        (wd:Q7377 "Mammals") (wd:Q5113 "Birds") (wd:Q10811 "Reptiles") (wd:Q10908 "Amphibians")
        (wd:Q127282 "Fishes") (wd:Q25371 "Fishes") (wd:Q1390 "Insects") (wd:Q1358 "Arachnids")
        (wd:Q25364 "Crustaceans") (wd:Q25326 "Molluscs") (wd:Q729 "Other animals")
        (wd:Q756 "Plants") (wd:Q764 "Fungi") }
      ?item wdt:P171+ ?taxon .
    }') |>
    mutate(rank = match(group, group_levels)) |>
    group_by(item) |>
    slice_min(rank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    select(item, group)

  species |>
    distinct(item, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    left_join(groups, by = "item") |>
    mutate(
      group  = factor(coalesce(group, "Other"), levels = group_levels),
      status = ifelse(grepl("Q239509$", status), "Extinct in the Wild", "Extinct"),
      common = ifelse(common == species, NA, common),
      year   = ifelse(year > 1500 & year <= as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")), year, NA)
    ) |>
    arrange(group, species)
}, error = function(e) NULL)
```

::: panel-tabset
## CO2 Concentration

The Keeling Curve, named after Charles Keeling who began measurements in 1958, is one of the most iconic datasets in climate science. It tracks the rise in atmospheric CO2 at Mauna Loa, Hawaii, far from local pollution sources, providing a clean global signal. The seasonal oscillations reflect plant breathing cycles; the upward trend reflects fossil fuel emissions.

```{r co2_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(co2)) {
  last_val <- tail(co2, 1)

  plot_ly(co2) |>
    add_lines(x = ~date, y = ~average,
              name = "Monthly mean",
              line = list(color = "#E76F51", width = 1, opacity = 0.7),
              hovertemplate = "<b>%{x|%b %Y}</b><br>CO2: %{y:.1f} ppm<extra></extra>") |>
    add_lines(x = ~date, y = ~deseason,
              name = "Deseasonalized trend",
              line = list(color = "#264653", width = 2.5),
              hovertemplate = "<b>%{x|%b %Y}</b><br>Trend: %{y:.1f} ppm<extra></extra>") |>
    add_annotations(
      x = last_val$date, y = last_val$average,
      text = paste0("<b>", round(last_val$average, 1), " ppm</b>"),
      xanchor = "right", showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(color = "#E76F51", size = 13)
    ) |>
    layout(
      title = list(text = "Atmospheric CO2 -- Mauna Loa Observatory (NOAA)", x = 0),
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = "CO2 (ppm)"),
      legend = list(x = 0.05, y = 0.95, bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)"),
      hovermode = "x unified",
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    )
} else {
  cat("Could not fetch CO2 data.")
}
```

## Global Temperature

Annual global surface temperature anomaly combining land and ocean measurements (NASA GISTEMP v4). The bar chart uses the original 1951--1980 baseline; the warming stripes below are re-centred to the 1961--1990 norm following Ed Hawkins' original design.

::: callout-note
## About Warming Stripes

The climate stripes show the annual temperature anomaly from the norm period **1961--1990**. Red stripes represent warmer years and blue stripes represent cooler years -- the darker the color, the greater the departure from the norm. The original design was created by **Ed Hawkins** (University of Reading). Climate stripes for more than 200 countries, states and cities are freely available at [showyourstripes.info](https://showyourstripes.info/s).
:::

```{r temp_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(temp)) {
  plot_ly(temp) |>
    add_bars(x = ~year, y = ~anomaly,
             color = ~sign,
             colors = c("Warmer" = "#E63946", "Cooler" = "#457B9D"),
             hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>Anomaly: %{y:+.3f} C<extra></extra>") |>
    add_lines(x = ~year, y = ~smooth,
              name = "10-yr running mean",
              line = list(color = "#1D3557", width = 2.5),
              hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>10-yr mean: %{y:+.3f} C<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(
      title = list(text = "Global Surface Temperature Anomaly -- NASA GISTEMP v4 (baseline 1951-1980)", x = 0),
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = "Temperature anomaly (C)", zeroline = TRUE,
                   zerolinecolor = "#aaaaaa", zerolinewidth = 1),
      legend = list(x = 0.05, y = 0.95, bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)"),
      hovermode = "x unified",
      barmode = "overlay",
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    )
} else {
  cat("Could not fetch temperature data.")
}
```

```{r stripes_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(temp)) {
  plot_ly(
    z      = matrix(temp$anomaly_stripes, nrow = 1),
    x      = temp$year,
    y      = c(""),
    type   = "heatmap",
    colorscale = list(
      list(0,    "#1D3557"),
      list(0.3,  "#457B9D"),
      list(0.5,  "#f5f5f5"),
      list(0.7,  "#E63946"),
      list(1,    "#7a0000")
    ),
    zmin   = -1.5,
    zmax   =  1.5,
    showscale   = FALSE,
    hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>%{z:+.2f} C vs 1961-1990 norm<extra></extra>"
  ) |>
    layout(
      height = 130,
      title  = list(text = "Warming Stripes (1880-present, baseline 1961-1990)", x = 0),
      xaxis  = list(title = "", tickfont = list(size = 10)),
      yaxis  = list(showticklabels = FALSE, ticks = ""),
      margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 40, b = 10),
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    )
} else {
  cat("Could not render warming stripes.")
}
```

## CO2 vs Temperature

The relationship between rising CO2 and warming is one of the most studied links in climate science. Each point represents one year (1958--present), colored from early (blue) to recent (red), showing how the two signals co-evolved once continuous CO2 measurements began at Mauna Loa.

```{r scatter_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(co2) && !is.null(temp)) {
  co2_annual <- co2 |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarise(co2_mean = mean(average, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  combined <- inner_join(co2_annual, temp |> select(year, anomaly), by = "year")

  plot_ly(combined,
          x = ~co2_mean, y = ~anomaly,
          color = ~year, colors = colorRamp(c("#A8DADC", "#457B9D", "#E63946")),
          text = ~year,
          type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
          marker = list(size = 8, opacity = 0.85),
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>CO2: %{x:.1f} ppm<br>Anomaly: %{y:+.3f} C<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(
      title = list(text = "CO2 Concentration vs Global Temperature Anomaly", x = 0),
      xaxis = list(title = "Annual mean CO2 (ppm)"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Temperature anomaly (C)"),
      coloraxis = list(colorbar = list(title = "Year")),
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    )
} else {
  cat("Could not compute scatter (missing CO2 or temperature data).")
}
```

## Biodiversity & Extinctions

Climate change is now one of the main drivers of biodiversity loss, alongside land-use change, overexploitation, pollution and invasive species. The [IUCN Red List](https://www.iucnredlist.org/) classifies species from *Least Concern* to *Extinct*; a species is considered **threatened** when it is *Vulnerable*, *Endangered* or *Critically Endangered*. `r if (!is.null(threatened_all) && !is.null(extinct_all)) paste0("Of the **", format(threatened_all$evaluated_species, big.mark = ","), "** species assessed so far, **", format(threatened_all$threatened_species, big.mark = ","), "** (", round(100 * threatened_all$threatened_species / threatened_all$evaluated_species), "%) are threatened with extinction, and **", format(extinct_all$ex, big.mark = ","), "** are documented as extinct since 1500 (IUCN Red List ", threatened_all$year, ").") else ""`

### Trends over time

The **Living Planet Index** tracks the average change in size of monitored vertebrate populations since 1970 (1 = 1970 level). The **Red List Index** summarises the overall extinction risk of species groups that have been repeatedly assessed (1 = all species *Least Concern*, 0 = all species extinct).

```{r lpi_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(lpi)) {
  last_lpi <- tail(lpi, 1)

  plot_ly(lpi, x = ~year) |>
    add_ribbons(ymin = ~ci_low, ymax = ~ci_high,
                name = "95% confidence interval",
                fillcolor = "rgba(42,157,143,0.2)", line = list(width = 0),
                hoverinfo = "skip") |>
    add_lines(y = ~lpi_final,
              name = "Living Planet Index",
              line = list(color = "#2A9D8F", width = 2.5),
              hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>Index: %{y:.2f}<extra></extra>") |>
    add_annotations(
      x = last_lpi$year, y = last_lpi$lpi_final,
      text = paste0("<b>", round(100 * (last_lpi$lpi_final - 1)), "% since 1970</b>"),
      xanchor = "right", showarrow = TRUE, arrowcolor = "#2A9D8F",
      ax = -60, ay = -50,
      font = list(color = "#2A9D8F", size = 13)
    ) |>
    layout(
      title = list(text = "Living Planet Index -- monitored wildlife populations (WWF / ZSL)", x = 0),
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = "Index (1970 = 1)", rangemode = "tozero"),
      legend = list(x = 0.6, y = 0.95, bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)"),
      hovermode = "x unified",
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    )
} else {
  cat("Could not fetch Living Planet Index data.")
}
```

```{r rli_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(rli)) {
  plot_ly(rli, x = ~year, y = ~rli,
          type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          name = "Red List Index",
          line = list(color = "#E76F51", width = 2.5),
          marker = list(color = "#E76F51", size = 6),
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>Red List Index: %{y:.3f}<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(
      title = list(text = "Red List Index -- global extinction risk (IUCN, SDG 15.5.1)", x = 0),
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = "Red List Index (1 = no extinction risk)"),
      showlegend = FALSE,
      hovermode = "x unified",
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    )
} else {
  cat("Could not fetch Red List Index data.")
}
```

### Threatened and extinct species by group

Number of threatened species (*Vulnerable*, *Endangered*, *Critically Endangered*) per group among the species assessed by the IUCN, and number of species documented as *Extinct* or *Extinct in the Wild* since 1500. Many groups (insects, fungi, plants) are still far from fully assessed, so these numbers are lower bounds.

```{r threatened_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(threatened)) {
  plot_ly(threatened, height = 550,
          x = ~threatened_species, y = ~entity,
          type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = "#E63946"),
          customdata = ~evaluated_species,
          text = ~paste0(share, "%"),
          textposition = "none",
          hovertemplate = paste0("<b>%{y}</b><br>Threatened: %{x:,}",
                                 "<br>Assessed: %{customdata:,}",
                                 "<br>Share threatened: %{text}<extra></extra>")) |>
    layout(
      title = list(text = paste0("Threatened species by group -- IUCN Red List (", threatened_all$year, ")"), x = 0),
      xaxis = list(title = "Number of threatened species"),
      yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = threatened$entity),
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    )
} else {
  cat("Could not fetch threatened species data.")
}
```

```{r extinct_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(extinct)) {
  plot_ly(extinct, y = ~entity, height = 450) |>
    add_bars(x = ~ex, name = "Extinct",
             marker = list(color = "#264653"),
             hovertemplate = "<b>%{y}</b><br>Extinct: %{x}<extra></extra>") |>
    add_bars(x = ~ew, name = "Extinct in the Wild",
             marker = list(color = "#E9C46A"),
             hovertemplate = "<b>%{y}</b><br>Extinct in the Wild: %{x}<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(
      title = list(text = paste0("Species extinct since 1500 by group -- IUCN Red List (", extinct_all$year, ")"), x = 0),
      barmode = "stack",
      xaxis = list(title = "Number of species"),
      yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = extinct$entity),
      legend = list(x = 0.6, y = 0.1, bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)"),
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    )
} else {
  cat("Could not fetch extinct species data.")
}
```

### Extinct species list

Species whose current IUCN status is *Extinct* or *Extinct in the Wild*, retrieved from Wikidata. The timeline shows the subset of species for which an extinction date is documented (often the last confirmed sighting); the table lists all of them and can be searched and filtered by group, status or year. Wikidata counts can differ slightly from the official IUCN totals above.

```{r extinct_timeline, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(extinct_list) && any(!is.na(extinct_list$year))) {
  dated <- extinct_list |> filter(!is.na(year)) |> mutate(group = droplevels(group))

  plot_ly(dated,
          x = ~year, y = ~group,
          type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
          marker = list(size = 9, color = "#264653", opacity = 0.7,
                        line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 1)),
          text = ~ifelse(is.na(common), species, paste0(common, " (", species, ")")),
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>%{y} -- extinct around %{x}<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(
      title = list(text = paste0("Documented extinction dates (", nrow(dated), " of ",
                                 nrow(extinct_list), " species, Wikidata)"), x = 0),
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = rev(levels(dated$group))),
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    )
} else {
  cat("Could not fetch the extinct species list from Wikidata.")
}
```

```{r extinct_table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(extinct_list)) {
  extinct_list |>
    mutate(
      species = paste0("<i>", species, "</i>"),
      links = paste0(
        ifelse(is.na(iucn), "",
               paste0('<a href="https://www.iucnredlist.org/details/', iucn, '/0" target="_blank">IUCN</a> &middot; ')),
        '<a href="', item, '" target="_blank">Wikidata</a>')
    ) |>
    select(`Scientific name` = species, `Common name` = common, Group = group,
           Status = status, `Extinction date` = year, Links = links) |>
    datatable(
      escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
      options = list(pageLength = 10, autoWidth = TRUE,
                     order = list(list(4, "desc")),
                     language = list(search = "Search:"))
    )
}
```
